rules.text: "orientation" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting horizontal | vertical. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.

"variant" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting discrete | subtle | soft | defined | strong | expressive | dark-blue. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.
